❌ MYTH: Republicans cut $880 billion from Medicaid.

✅ FACT: Medicaid funding under the One Big Beautiful Bill will increase by 25% over the next 10 years. Only in Washington D.C. is an increase a cut!

❌ MYTH: Tens of millions of Americans will lose Medicaid because of the One Big Beautiful Bill.

✅ FACT: Under this bill, the only individuals who stand to lose Medicaid coverage over the next 10 years are the estimated 1.4 million illegal immigrants, 1.2 million individuals that do not qualify for Medicaid to begin with, and 4.8 million able-bodied individuals who choose not to meet community engagement requirements.

North Dakota’s farmers and ranchers help feed and fuel the world. 🚜🌎

❌ MYTH: The One Big Beautiful Bill cuts Medicare and Social Security benefits.

✅ FACT: The bill does NOT touch these programs. Importantly, it reduces taxes on Social Security for seniors by allowing a new $4,000 deduction for those earning under $75,000 individually or $150,000 for married couples.
